programs.title: Woman at the end of the world
programs.desc: Martyna goes to Saint Petersburg, where she will meet Larisa Renar, who runs the Academy of Private Life.Women can find answers to all their questions about women's and men's issues there.Over 150,000 students have already completed courses conducted by Larisa - not only from Russia, but also from China, England, the United Arab Emirates, Bulgaria and Turkey.The heroine of the episode completed her MBA;is a psychologist, motivational trainer, and author of eight guides for women.For Russian women, whose salary is 1/3 less than men's, marriage has not only a romantic aspect, but also a business one.Hence the popularity of Larissa Academy.

programs.title: Woman at the end of the world
programs.desc: Martyna Wojciechowska will visit Florida, where Maja Kazawiedź lives - a woman who escaped from a war-torn country - and Winter the dolphin.At Clearwater Marine Aquarium, the fates of man and animal intertwine.The heroine of the episode comes from Bosnia.She was fifteen years old when armed conflict broke out in the former Yugoslavia in 1992.Winter, in turn, as a 2-month-old baby, became entangled in the nets.Both of them came close to death, but survived thanks to their extraordinary determination and exceptional strength of character.Today they support others.Their story helped Martyna Wojciechowska in her own struggles with adversity.

programs.title: Aloha, new home
programs.desc: Spouses Kamohai and Tristyn Kalama are native Hawaiians whose passion and mission is to renovate abandoned houses on the island of Oahu.Contrary to appearances, it is not just pleasant work in beautiful natural surroundings.Many of these properties are in a deplorable condition due to moisture, wind and sun.Renovations are additionally complicated by difficult terrain and changeable weather.However, the reward for designers is the end result, which is worth every moment spent renovating these amazing buildings.

programs.title: Manhunt with Joel Lambert
programs.desc: Former Navy SEAL, Joel Lambert, faces an elite reconnaissance unit of the American army.Within two days, he must cover a specific route so as not to get caught.During this unusual mission, he can use the items he has in his backpack and what he finds along the way.Thanks to modern filming techniques, viewers follow the manhunt, both from the point of view of the hunted and the commandos tracking him.The program was shot in the United States, Poland, South Africa, the Philippines, Panama and South Korea.

programs.title: Island Life 8
programs.desc: The program presents the stories of people whose desire was to live on an island, in a picturesque area, where the hustle and bustle of the city does not reach. There are those who care about a tropical climate and those who would like to live on islands in the Washington area and have a view of the mountains.Real estate agents will present properties in various price ranges to program participants.From those at an extremely affordable price to the most expensive and luxurious ones.Viewers will find out what the enthusiasts of island life will choose and whether their dreams will finally become a reality.
